title: LLM-Generated Feature Pools for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.21801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how far a simple statistical pipeline can go on univariate time series anomaly detection under a strict selection protocol. The method extracts a small pool of statistics over sliding windows, scores each window with a transductive robust (MAD) model, and selects a feature subset per domain on a held-out tuning split. On TSB-AD-U it reaches $0.529$ per-series VUS-PR, above the best neural ($0.45$) and statistical ($0.44$) entries on the public leaderboard and within $0.06$ of the strongest pretrained foundation model, several of which use more supervision than ours. Ablations locate the cause: across three selection strategies and a hindsight oracle the score moves by $0.031$, and across the aggregation grid by $0.096$, while changing the candidate pool moves it by $0.226$. The candidate pool sets the ceiling; the search over it is second-order. We therefore generate a pool per domain by prompting a multimodal LLM with in-contex

translated_title: 基于大语言模型生成特征池的时间序列异常检测
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个简单的统计流程在严格选择协议下能在单变量时间序列异常检测上达到何种水平。该方法在滑动窗口上提取一小组统计量，使用直推式鲁棒（MAD）模型对每个窗口进行评分，并在留出的调优数据划分上为每个领域选择特征子集。在TSB-AD-U基准上，该方法达到了0.529的每序列VUS-PR，高于公开排行榜上最佳的神经方法（0.45）和统计方法（0.44），且与最强的预训练基础模型相差不到0.06，而其中一些基础模型使用了比我们更多的监督信息。消融实验定位了性能的关键来源：在三种特征选择策略和事后预言机之间，分数仅变化0.031；在聚合网格之间变化0.096；而改变候选特征池则使分数变化0.226。由此可见，候选特征池决定了性能上限，而对其的搜索只是次要因素。因此，我们通过向多模态大语言模型进行上下文提示，为每个领域生成相应的特征池。
tldr: 该论文发现候选特征池的质量是时间序列异常检测性能上限的决定性因素，并通过提示多模态大语言模型为每个领域自动生成特征池，使简单的统计流程在TSB-AD-U基准上超越了最佳的神经方法和统计方法。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the candidate feature pool sets the performance ceiling in time series anomaly detection, and generates domain-specific feature pools by prompting a multimodal LLM, enabling a simple statistical pipeline to outperform the best neural and statistical methods on TSB-AD-U.
